sections.kicker: Prepared for Made By Lorena by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a business owner in Sydney would. Here is what stood out.
sections.thesis: Made By Lorena shows the work beautifully and never says what she does.
sections.keep: Your project lines, like "Commercial property, taken seriously." Each one shows you understood the client before the design.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Made By Lorena Work About Services Contact
pins.what: The first screen is a name and a menu.
pins.why: A visitor has to open Services to learn you do brand and websites, which is the slow start you described.
pins.how: Put one line under the name that says who you work for and what you make for them.
pins.label: Your first screen
pins.cost: Business owners skim the photos and leave unsure if you would take their job.

pins.what: Your Instagram says it in one line. The site does not.
pins.why: "Your Creative Department." is the clearest offer you have, and it is the reason to pick you over a freelancer with one skill.
pins.how: Bring this line to the top of the site and build the work around it.
pins.label: Your Instagram
pins.cost: The best explanation of the business lives where fewer clients look.

pins.quote: Booked for the support, stayed for the headliner
pins.what: Your captions are the voice, and they are tiny.
pins.why: Booked for the support, stayed for the headliner has wit that a template portfolio cannot copy.
pins.how: Give these lines the size of a headline.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: The part that sounds like you reads like a footnote.

sections.intro: You said people do not get it fast enough. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Here is where the time goes.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Made By Lorena's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Pentagram, from another scale entirely. Its home page is the work, but the line under each piece tells you the problem it solved.
